newsitem.title: UK: New Jersey sets $2.8 billion multi-tranche bond. [CORRECTED 15:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: New Jersey sets $2.8 billion multi-tranche bond. [CORRECTED 15:55 GMT]

text.p: The state of New Jersy has set a $2.8 billion multi-tranche global issue, lead manager Merrill Lynch said on Wednesday.
The issue is split between a fixed-rate tranche worth $1.3 billion and 28 zero-coupon bonds totalling $1.5 billion.
The $1.3 billion fixed rate bond has a legal final maturity of February 15, 2029 and has an expected average life of 29.855 years.
It is to be priced at 66 basis points over the 6.50 percent November 2025 U.S. treasury.
The 28 zero-coupon bonds have consecutive maturities from one-year to 29-years, but excluding a two-year bond.
